# DataDock — MVGR Data Engineering Academic Portal

> The centralized, official academic repository and e-learning cloud for the Department of Data Engineering at Maharaj Vijayaram Gajapathi Raj (MVGR) College of Engineering (Autonomous), Vizianagaram, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Primary Canonical URL
- Website: https://datadock.aswinsai.tech

## Overview & Purpose
DataDock provides students and faculty with verified, peer-reviewed academic learning materials, autonomous regulation course syllabi (Semesters 1 to 8), previous year question papers, lab manuals, and mid-examination question banks for undergraduate B.Tech programs.

## Department Specializations & Academic Tracks
- **Cyber Security & IoT (CIC)**: Comprehensive coverage of network defense, ethical hacking, cryptography, embedded IoT hardware, sensor networks, cloud security, and digital forensics.
- **Data Science (CSD)**: Deep coverage of big data architectures (Hadoop, Spark), data mining, predictive modeling, statistical learning, business analytics, and data warehousing.
- **Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (CSM)**: In-depth materials for neural networks, deep learning architectures, computer vision, natural language processing (NLP), reinforcement learning, and generative AI systems.

## Key Features & Available Resources
- **Verified Lecture Notes**: Semester-by-semester unit-wise notes authored and verified by MVGR faculty coordinators.
- **Autonomous Regulation Syllabi**: Full credit structure, course objectives, and outcomes for Semesters 1 through 8 under UGC Autonomous regulations.
- **Lab Manuals & Practical Codes**: Step-by-step experiment procedures, sample outputs, viva questions, and source code repositories.
- **Question Banks & Previous Papers**: Mid-semester question papers, semester-end university examination papers, and model solution sets.
- **Personal Student Vault & Bookmarks**: Custom bookmarking and study tracking system for enrolled students.
- **Faculty Curriculum Hub**: Content publishing, cohort management, and content versioning.
